baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative tasting verb at word 1 governs severe punishment at words 4-5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired emphatic futures turn punishment from a reported destination into compelled bodily knowledge: the addressees are made to register it as directly as taste, with severity supplying force and resistance.

activation_trace.role: Mouth-tasting supplies literal bodily contact and makes the penalty personally registered rather than merely announced.
Learning a thing by undergoing it expands taste into experiential verification and drives the threat's epistemic force.
Painful punishment supplies the adverse object that the tasting construction forces into experience.
Concentrated strength and hardness make the experienced penalty resistant to evasion or attenuation.

changed_reading.before: The disbelievers will receive a severe punishment.
changed_reading.after: They will be forced to know the severe punishment through direct embodied experience; warning becomes verified sensation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second emphatic clause joins recompense at word 6 to the worst at word 7 of what they habitually did at words 9-10.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recompense answers intentional practice with a commensurate return, while the superlative selects the ugliest register within an accumulated history of work. The verse therefore relates penalty to practiced action rather than attaching it arbitrarily to a label.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal payment for an act supplies the action-to-return relation that organizes the second clause.
Ugliness and bad quality supply the scale on which their practiced acts are selected as worst.
Occurrence through past time turns the deeds into an established history rather than a single isolated act.
Purposive action supplies the accountable material whose quality determines the return.

changed_reading.before: God will punish them for their deeds.
changed_reading.after: The return is calibrated to the ugliest quality of an established practice of intentional acts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Those designated by the covering root at word 3 are made to taste the worst of their own work.
baseline_models.mechanism: Covering and truth-blocking create distance from what is rejected; compelled tasting cancels that distance. The concealed ugly content of their practice becomes an unavoidable encounter.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the protective or concealing motion that the later forced encounter reverses.
Blocking acknowledged truth identifies the covering as an epistemic act, not only a static group label.
A shameful thing normally kept covered supplies an exploratory exposure image for the worst content of their work.
Intentional work keeps the exposure model attached to what they themselves practiced.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers are a named class who are punished.
changed_reading.after: Those who actively covered truth lose the distance created by covering and must encounter the ugly content of their own practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier challenge of work against work and the contrasting promise of an uncut wage establish a surah-wide sorting mechanism: purposive practice issues in a corresponding return. The focus verse occupies the adverse side of that mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Purposive work anchors the focus clause in accountable practice.
The paired command and answer present opposed parties as deliberately carrying out their respective work.
Righteous intentional action supplies the positive comparison class for the focus verse's worst work.
A wage or return for work makes the action-to-outcome relation explicit on the positive side.
The image of cutting off supplies the negated limit on righteous reward and sharpens the contrast with adverse recompense.

structural_cues: 41:5 repeats the work root as a reciprocal challenge, and 41:8 immediately couples righteous work to an uncut wage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed work and an explicit positive wage; I infer a shared sorting framework whose negative arm appears in 41:27. A live alternative is that these are separate rhetorical contrasts rather than one accounting mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse independently threatens repayment for bad deeds.
changed_reading.after: It resolves an earlier contest of practices within a two-sided work-to-return system: righteous work receives an uncut wage, while the opposing practice returns in its worst register.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claim of superior strength is answered by greater strength and then by an episode in which punishment is made experientially known. The focus adjective severe therefore does more than intensify pain: it recalls a demonstrated contest in which arrogant power failed under load.

activation_trace.role: Concentrated strength anchors the focus penalty to the earlier dispute over which strength can prevail.
The repeated strength comparison supplies the explicit contested scale later carried by severe punishment.
Strength gathered like strands under tension makes the boast and its answer a test of load-bearing power.
A prior caused experience of punishment supplies a demonstrated precedent for the focus threat.
The repeated painful penalty connects the historical demonstration directly to the focus object.
Public abasement makes the failed strength claim visible rather than leaving the defeat private.
What was actively acquired ties the demonstrated penalty back to the agents' own conduct.

structural_cues: 41:15 poses and answers the question of greater strength.
41:16-17 immediately narrate caused tasting and punishment as the consequence of acquisition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a strength boast, its correction, and a caused tasting sequence; I infer that severity in 41:27 reactivates this failed stress test. The alternative is that the earlier episode serves only as an example of punishment without modifying the adjective.

changed_reading.before: Severe only marks a high degree of pain.
changed_reading.after: Severity also answers the addressees' power claim: punishment is the load under which their asserted strength is experimentally disproved.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hearing, sight, and skin become present witnesses to the very work named in the focus verse, and attempted concealment fails when the body is made articulate. The later tasting penalty consequently uses the same embodied interface that authenticates the deed record.

activation_trace.role: Intentional work anchors the model to the focus verse's object of recompense.
Presence with direct witnessing turns past work into evidence carried by those who underwent it.
The body's covering surface becomes an evidentiary organ and links judgment to embodied experience.
The exact recurrence of work identifies what the bodily witnesses attest.
Sign-bearing articulation supplies the mechanism by which mute bodily evidence becomes intelligible testimony.
Attempted covering supplies the failed concealment that bodily testimony defeats.

structural_cues: 41:20 says the organs testify concerning what they used to do; 41:21 makes them speak; 41:22 denies that concealment could prevent their testimony.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily witnesses, articulation, failed concealment, and the same work formula; I infer that the body functions as a self-authenticating deed record and later as the site of tasting. A live alternative is that the organs are external witnesses to acts rather than carriers of an inscription.

changed_reading.before: Their works are external facts consulted before punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their practiced acts become bodily self-evidence: the sensorium that witnessed the deeds authenticates them and then becomes the site of compelled tasting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding strategy blocks reception by commanding non-hearing and flooding the message with noise in pursuit of dominance. The focus reverses agency and sensory control: those who tried to prevent an auditory experience are made to undergo an unavoidable gustatory one.

activation_trace.role: Literal tasting anchors the reversal in a second sensory channel that the addressees cannot shut down.
Truth-blocking identifies non-hearing and noise as an active denial mechanism by the same subject group.
Auditory perception supplies the reception channel they explicitly command one another to disable.
Mixed clamor supplies the active masking technique used to keep the recitation from registering.
Overpowering force supplies their intended outcome, which the compelled tasting clause reverses.

structural_cues: 41:26 and 41:27 are adjacent, retain the same subject designation, and move directly from do not hear and make noise to We will surely make them taste.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberate sensory masking followed immediately by a causative sensory verb; I infer a reversal from controlled non-reception to forced reception. The alternative is that taste is only a conventional experience idiom and the auditory contrast is rhetorical rather than mechanistic.

changed_reading.before: Tasting is simply a vivid synonym for suffering punishment.
changed_reading.after: Tasting is forced reception: their campaign to stop the message from being heard ends with an experience they cannot mask, outshout, or control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats recompense, identifies fire, and gives it an abiding residential horizon. This prevents the small, momentary scale of an ordinary taste from limiting the threat: tasting functions as entry into a condition that persists.

activation_trace.role: A bounded mouth-taste supplies the small-scale event whose temporal scope the following ayah enlarges.
Act-for-act recompense anchors the focus threat to the explicit identification that follows.
The doubled naming of recompense resolves the focus clause into a specified consequence.
Kindled fire supplies the concrete environment in which the focus punishment is experienced.
Persistence without quick decay expands the tasting event into an enduring condition.
Denial despite knowledge reconnects the specified consequence to the epistemic refusal that produced it.

structural_cues: 41:28 begins by identifying the preceding threat as recompense, repeats the recompense noun, and names an abode of persistence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a moment-scale tasting image followed by an abiding environment; I infer that taste marks experiential entry, not duration. The alternative is that taste already means experience without any onset implication.

changed_reading.before: They undergo a sharp but temporally unspecified taste of punishment.
changed_reading.after: The compelled taste is the experiential threshold of an abiding state, not a fleeting sample.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later maxim routes good action to the agent's own benefit and bad action upon the agent, while excluding withheld right. It clarifies the focus recompense as a non-arbitrary return curve in which practiced badness comes back upon its practitioner.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal payment anchors the later self-return mechanism to the focus act of recompense.
Purposive action starts the explicit routing rule from deed to doer.
The agent's own self supplies the destination to which the action's value returns.
Bad quality supplies the negative payload explicitly placed upon the acting self.
Withholding a due right supplies the injustice excluded from the action-to-self routing.

structural_cues: 41:46 uses parallel for himself and upon it clauses, then denies injustice by the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit directional prepositions from action to self and an exclusion of injustice; I infer that 41:27's recompense realizes this return path. The alternative is a juridical award that remains external even though it is fairly assigned.

changed_reading.before: The worst deeds serve as evidence for an externally selected sentence.
changed_reading.after: Their practiced badness is routed back upon their own selves through a recompense that withholds no right.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later ayah applies caused tasting first to mercy after harm and then to punishment after an account of work. Taste is therefore a neutral channel of knowledge by undergoing, whose polarity comes from its object; the thickening image adds material density to the focus severity.

activation_trace.role: Experiential knowledge anchors the focus threat in a channel that can carry more than pain.
The same caused-experience root carries both mercy and punishment, proving that the object rather than the channel determines valence.
Tender benefit supplies the positive object of tasting and prevents taste itself from meaning pain.
Being struck by an effect supplies the prior harmful contact against which tasted mercy is registered.
Delivered information supplies verbal disclosure of their deeds before caused tasting supplies experiential verification.
The recurrence of intentional work preserves the focus relation between what was practiced and what is experienced.
Painful punishment restores the negative object in the later near-repetition of the focus wording.
Thickness after thinness gives the punishment material density alongside the focus adjective's force.

structural_cues: 41:50 contains both tasting mercy and making the disbelievers taste punishment, then repeats the focus links among disbelief, work, tasting, and punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite objects governed by the same tasting root and a disclosure-before-experience sequence; I infer a neutral experiential verification channel. The alternative is that the two uses are independent conventional idioms without a designed polarity.

changed_reading.before: Taste is a figurative synonym specialized for suffering.
changed_reading.after: Taste is knowledge through undergone contact, equally able to verify mercy or punishment; in 41:27 the punitive object makes that neutral channel severe.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because bow-testing is a branch-distant image, but it is supplied for the focus tasting root and is sharpened by severe plus the nearby contest of strength. Render it only as an exploratory stress-test analogy, never as a replacement gloss for the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The tasting verb at 41:27 word 1 and severe at word 5 stand near the repeated strength contest in 41:15.

activation_trace.role: Drawing or examining a bow to test it supplies the exploratory image of punishment putting a power claim under tension.
Hard strength supplies the property being tested in the focus penalty.
Gathered tensile strength supplies the nearby boast and counterclaim that the focus threat can imaginatively stress-test.

changed_reading.before: They are made to sample an intense punishment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the punishment draws their boasted power under tension as a bow is tested, revealing that the claim cannot bear the load.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant split mapping of the focus recompense root and combines it with later fruit imagery. It remains packet-anchored through the explicit split branch, the focus covering and work roots, and 41:47's fruit emerging from sheaths; render it as a material harvest analogy, not as an etymology or lexical equation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sequence joins covering at word 3, recompensing at word 6, and practiced work at word 10.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed with earth supplies the concealed beginning of an exploratory cultivation sequence.
The non-dominant branch's time of cutting when growth is ripe supplies harvest as an image for recompense becoming due.
Intentional work supplies the cultivation-like process whose result eventually matures.
Emergence from concealment supplies the transition from hidden growth to exposed result.
Ripe fruit supplies the matured output of the work process.
The fruit sheath supplies the temporary covering from which the result finally emerges.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is a judicial payment assigned after completed deeds.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, practiced covering cultivates a result that ripens under its sheath, emerges, and reaches its cutting time as the worst harvest of their work.

strongest_changes: The adjacency of 41:26-27 turns tasting into forced sensory reception after deliberate non-hearing and masking noise.
The bodily testimony sequence in 41:20-22 makes practiced work self-authenticating evidence within the same sensorium that later tastes punishment.
The exact polarity in 41:50 shows taste as neutral experiential verification, carrying mercy as well as punishment.
The self-routing rule in 41:46 clarifies recompense as practiced badness returning upon its agent without withheld right.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed a repeated sensory and evidentiary mechanism: blocked hearing, bodily testimony, compelled tasting, and later polarity between tasted mercy and tasted punishment.
remaining_uncertainties: The grammatical scope of worst may select the worst deeds, the worst quality of their practice, or the adverse grade of recompense.
Bodily testimony clearly authenticates work, but the stronger notion of the body storing an inscription remains a reader-supplied inference.
Whether taste marks entry into an enduring state or simply means experience remains open.
The bow-test and harvest-cut activations are deliberately contained material analogies, not lexical claims.
